published_ranges._ams: Creality says use with a direct-drive extruder; Shore hardness not published, so AMS suitability unknown.
published_ranges._notes: Creality filament parameter reference table (2024-12-23): recommended 225C nozzle, 50C bed, 15 mm/s. K2 Plus table: 220C/40C, 2 mm3/s (printer profile values).
